description: Fit a video or GIF to a destination's size budget at the best quality that fits, and optionally share it. A native encoder searches width, fps, palette and tolerance and scores every candidate against the source, so the result carries a measured quality (quality.dssim; under 0.01 is hard to notice). Applies every edit in one pass: trim, crop, join several clips, speed, reverse, boomerang, captions with a place and a time, blur, pixelate, zoom, colour, fades, border, rounded corners, a colour key, sound on MP4. Returns size, whether it fit, the steps tried, and with share=true a link to the finished file. Works without local ffmpeg via the hosted service (remote=true, or automatically).

alt.description: Alt text for the markdown/html embed.

async.description: Submit a background job; use gif_job with its ID to retrieve the result.

audio.description: Keep the sound on MP4 output (default true when the source has a track; GIF and WebP have none).

blur.description: Regions to blur, in source pixels like crop (e.g. '200x40+30+90', 'top-right', '10%,5%,30%,8%'); an optional :radius.

border.description: A border around the picture: '8', '8,white', '12,#202020' (pixels, colour default black).

caption.description: Caption drawn over the clip, centred, with a translucent box. Needs an ffmpeg with drawtext; the hosted container has it.

captionPosition.description: Where the caption goes. Default bottom.

captions.description: Several captions: 'text', 'text @top', 'text @bottom-left', 'text @40%,10%'; a time range last: 'text @top 2-5' (seconds or m:ss).

colors.description: Pin palette size 2-256. Usually leave unset; the optimizer picks.

corners.description: Rounded corners of this radius in output pixels: transparent on GIF and WebP, black on MP4.

crop.description: left-half, right-half, top-half, bottom-half, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, center, left-third, center-third, right-third, WxH (centered), WxH+X+Y, or x,y,w,h. Numbers or percentages of the source.

dither.description: Dithering. 'none' is smallest and looks fine for flat UI recordings.

effort.description: How many encoder trials the search may spend. fast is about twice as quick, high squeezes a little more.

expires.description: How long the link lives: 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d, or never (free links last at most 90 days). Use a short one for recordings that show private things.

fadeIn.description: Fade from black over this many seconds at the start.

fadeOut.description: Fade to black over this many seconds at the end of the finished clip.

flip.description: Mirror: h = left-right, v = top-bottom, hv = both.

for.description: Destination preset. Sets format, size budget, default width, and fps.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to gif (the only format that animates in GitHub READMEs and most chat apps).

height.description: Pin the output height in px.

loop.description: 0 = loop forever (default), -1 = play once, n = loop n times.

lossy.description: Pin gifsicle lossy level 0-200. Usually leave unset.

max.description: Size budget like '5mb' or '800kb'. Overrides the preset budget.

objective.description: smallest (default): the smallest file whose measured quality stays within the threshold; quality: the best-scoring candidate that fits the budget, usually a larger file; fastest: the first fit.

out.description: Output path. Default: <name>.<target>.gif next to the source.

overlay.description: Image file laid over the frame: 'logo.png', 'logo.png@bottom-right', 'logo.png@10,10:25%'. Local runs only.

pad.description: Pad to an aspect ratio (16:9, 1:1) or a size (800x600), optionally with a colour: '16:9:white', '1:1:#202020'. Default black. Useful when a destination crops previews.

path.description: Source video or GIF. Append :START-END to use only that stretch.

paths.description: Several sources, joined end to end in this order before the recipe applies (each may carry :START-END). Use instead of path.

pixelate.description: Regions to pixelate, like blur; an optional :block size.

preview.description: Return a contact sheet of the optimized output (default true).

quality.description: Max perceptual loss (DSSIM) the native encoder may trade for size. Default 0.004; 0.002 is stricter, 0.01 is looser. Under 0.01 is hard to notice.

remote.description: Optimize on the configured share server instead of this machine. Use when gif_doctor reports ffmpeg missing; it also happens automatically in that case when a server is configured. The result is stored on the server and links are returned; pass out to also download it.

saturation.description: Saturation 0 to 3; 1 leaves it, 0 is grey.

share.description: Upload the result to the configured share server and return a link.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier; 2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half.

start.description: Trim start, seconds or m:ss (e.g. '2.5' or '0:02.5').

transparent.description: A colour to make transparent (GIF, WebP; black on MP4): '#00ff00' or '#00ff00:24' with a per-channel tolerance.

width.description: Pin the output width in px. Never upscaled.

zoom.description: Push in from the full frame to a region over N seconds (default 1.5), then hold: 'center:1.5', '40%x40%+10%+20%'.

name: gif_optimize
